💹 AI Investment Tracker, 2010–2026

How much money has gone into AI each year since 2010: global corporate investment in AI by year, the private (venture) part of it, generative AI, and 2026 quarter by quarter. Every number carries its source; ⚠️ marks figures we could only read from secondary reports.

Show:Scale:
Corporate investment in AI (M&A, minority stakes, private investment, public offerings)Private investmentGenerative AI (private)* 2026 Q1–Q3 venture funding (CB Insights, different measure)No comparable dataStriped = ⚠️ secondary source
Tap a bar for its source.

Where the money went: AI areas

Pick a year. 2023: private AI investment by focus area from the AI Index 2024 (Quid, Fig. 4.3.16; the four groups are our own grouping). 2026: the largest 2026 rounds by theme from our tracked rounds (company-reported amounts; a sample, not a total). The two use different categories.

2026 so far, quarter by quarter

2026 uses a different measure (global AI venture funding as reported by CB Insights and Crunchbase). The red 2026 bar in the chart is the CB Insights Q1–Q3 sum ($482.4B), drawn in its own colour because it is not the AI Index measure; Q4 is not reported yet. Other trackers give higher Q1 totals (Crunchbase ~$242B, PitchBook ~$255.5B ⚠️), and CB Insights later reportedly revised Q1 to $237.6B ⚠️.

The numbers

Method: Stanford AI Index figures use Quid data (companies with over $1.5M in investment). Each edition revises earlier years, so a later edition can show a different value for the same year; we keep the edition we read. 2024 and 2025 come from the 2026 edition as quoted in search excerpts and secondary reports, because the HAI site was not reachable from our build sandbox (⚠️). See also the AI Market Map for 2026 rounds by theme.
